newsitem.title: GERMANY: Stark - Germany keen to cover whole bond yield curve.
newsitem.headline: Stark - Germany keen to cover whole bond yield curve.

text.p: Juergen Stark, state secretary in the German finance ministry, said on Tuesday that Bonn was keen to ensure the full range of the bond yield curve was covered with government debt issues.
Stark also said that Bonn would maintain its philosophy of having a mix of bond issues across the curve and would not therefore simply bow to market calls for a larger issuance at the short end.
"We want to cover the whole range of the yield curve," Stark told a news conference at the Bundesbank.
The conference was called to announce the issuance of a new strippable 30-year bond, of which the Bundesbank said earlier it had sold 3.0 billion marks to a consortium of banks at a price of 99.75.
